title: Luge and Toboggan Run
tagline: Lie back, lean, hold the line
description: Slide feet first down a banked ice chute of numbered bends. Lean with one thumb, pick the fastest line and shave hundredths off every run, then race a ghost of your best and seven computer sliders in a two-run cup.
howToPlay: Tap as each ring closes at the start gate to launch faster.
Press and drag left or right to lean the sled through the bends.
Follow the gold line, stay off the walls and beat your ghost.
